dedupe_keys.name: kppip proyek prioritas status of indonesia s national priority infrastructure projects toll roads ports refineries water rail power urban transit broadband

description: The Committee for Acceleration of Priority Infrastructure Delivery (KPPIP) of Indonesia publishes the latest status of the national priority infrastructure projects it steers. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists them by sector: toll roads such as Balikpapan-Samarinda and fifteen sections of the Trans Sumatra toll road; hub ports at Kuala Tanjung, Bitung and Patimban and an inland waterway; oil and gas projects including the Bontang and Tuban refineries, the upgrade of five existing refineries and the Abadi Masela field; water and sanitation projects including Jakarta wastewater, regional drinking water systems and a sea wall; railways; power projects such as the Batang coal plant, 500 kV transmission lines in Java and Sumatra, waste-to-energy plants in eight cities and gas plants in 18 provinces; urban transit (Jakarta MRT and LRT, Palembang LRT); and the Palapa Ring broadband network, with a dashboard and a map of completed strategic projects. Coverage is Indonesia. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated. Caveats: status details sit on per-project pages and the dashboard, which were not opened. It supports capacity planning studies by listing planned national assets. Related record: PowerGen-ABM models Indonesian power plant expansion.
